# contract-tests-gen

> Generate readable pytest contract tests from an OpenAPI 3.x document, injection-safe, with a small schema validator, injectable transport and drift check. Python package `trysac-contract-tests-gen`, import name `contract_tests_gen`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, runtime dependency PyYAML only.
